title: Weight Space Learning for Certifiable Few-shot Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2502.06970v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In contemporary deep learning, a prevalent and effective workflow for solving low-data problems is adapting powerful pre-trained foundation models (FMs) to new tasks via parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). However, while empirically effective, the resulting solutions lack generalisation guarantees to certify their accuracy - which may be required for ethical or legal reasons prior to deployment in high-importance applications. In this paper we develop a novel transfer learning approach that is designed to facilitate non-vacuous learning theoretic generalisation guarantees for downstream tasks, even in the low-shot regime. Specifically, we first use upstream tasks to train a distribution over PEFT parameters. We then learn the downstream task by a sample-and-evaluate procedure -- sampling plausible PEFTs from the trained diffusion model and selecting the one with the highest likelihood on the downstream data. translated_title: 面向可认证少样本迁移学习的权重空间学习
translated_abstract: 在当代深度学习中，解决低数据问题的一个普遍且有效的工作流程是通过参数高效微调（PEFT）将强大的预训练基础模型（FM）适配到新任务上。然而，尽管这些方法在经验上有效，所得到的解决方案却缺乏能够认证其准确性的泛化保证——而在高重要性应用部署之前，出于伦理或法律方面的原因，可能需要这种保证。在本文中，我们开发了一种新颖的迁移学习方法，旨在即使在少样本情况下，也能为下游任务提供非空洞的学习理论泛化保证。具体而言，我们首先利用上游任务训练一个PEFT参数的分布。然后，我们通过一个“采样-评估”程序来学习下游任务——从训练好的扩散模型中采样合理的PEFT参数，并选择在下游数据上似然最高的那个。至关重要的是，这种配置（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新型迁移学习方法，通过在上游任务上训练PEFT参数的扩散模型分布，再利用采样-评估程序为下游任务选择最优参数，从而即使在少样本情况下也能获得可认证的非空洞学习理论泛化保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel transfer learning approach that trains a diffusion model distribution over PEFT parameters on upstream tasks and selects the best parameters via a sample-and-evaluate procedure, enabling non-vacuous, certifiable learning-theoretic generalization guarantees for downstream tasks even in the few-shot regime.
